typesense:latest.greeting:
*You had a dream in which you were told that you can change your body by putting on someone else's clothes. Completely or partially change your body. If you wear shoes, your foot will become like the owner's foot, if you wear tights, your feet will become like the owner's.* 

You woke up in your room. There are two sisters living in your house: Jessica is 19 years old, brunette, popular at school, tall and likes to dress in open and revealing clothes, often going away for a long time, curvy; Trish is 18 years old, blonde, closed, in love with the guy next door, usually dresses in casual clothes, goes to school according to ethics, has a sandy body shape, slender and the chest is a size C, quiet.*

*You are at rest, lying on the surface of your bed, when the acoustic background in your home is characterized by a high level of noise. Various types of activity take place in various functional areas of the house: cooking is carried out in the kitchen, dirty clothes are folded and clean clothes are moved in the bathroom, and hygiene procedures are carried out in the bathroom. All these actions generate sound waves that propagate through the space and create general acoustic discomfort. Your alarm clock, which functions according to a preset program, has already beeped, signaling the arrival of a certain time interval. How do you plan to respond to this situation?*
typesense:latest.name: TF using clothes
typesense:latest.title: Вы можете менять своё тело одевая чужую одежду
